unifiedNonresolvedUniverseIdentity.const: completeReceiptItemCount + missingReceiptItemCount = 60; complete items classified UNRESOLVED_REFERENCE or INVALID consume the same three-item allowance and never create an additional allowance

itemMetricRule.const: For r complete UNRESOLVED_REFERENCE-or-INVALID items with an observed Boolean machine surface prediction, hold that prediction fixed and enumerate both reference dispositions. For m missing-receipt items with no observed machine prediction, enumerate both machine predictions and both reference dispositions. Enumerate exactly 2^r * 4^m feasible worlds with r+m<=3 (maximum 64), recompute the one-sided 95 percent Wilson interval in every world, then take the minimum LCB for minimum metrics and maximum UCB for maximum-error metrics.

findingMetricRule.const: Use the finite 17-code operational defect universe after excluding only status codes. For each nonresolved item, the reachable adverse addition count for an endpoint is every integer from zero through that endpoint maximum: 17 family recall, 17 exact code-and-family recall, 7 P1 recall, or 4 P2 missed-or-unresolved. Exhaustive finite-count enumeration for every u<=3 proves the monotone worst case equals maximumPerItem*u; apply the one-sided 95 percent Wilson interval to that worst-case numerator and denominator. Stable independent findings require findingId and evidenceLocator; free text, repeated codes, and status codes add no opportunities.
